title: anthemis artemisioides
intro: Anthemis artemisioides, commonly known as California sagewort, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Anthemis artemisioides are attributed to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help in addressing various health concerns. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and essential oils, such as borneol and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
